newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $2.00 per cwt higher, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 80.00-89.50, including 60 head 597 lbs 80.05, blacks 37 head 548 lbs 93.60; 600-700 lbs 70.50-78.00, including 37 head 693 lbs 74.50, 34 head blacks 621 lbs 84.50; 700-800 lbs 69.50-74.25, including 22 head 737 lbs 74.25 blacks. Holsteins - Large 2 700-800 lbs few 45.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 60.50-69.90, including 35 head 611 lbs 69.90, blacks 43 head 628 lbs 74.00; 700-800 lbs 58.00-61.00.
